name: meu-artigo
description: Experimental research workflow plugin with human-controlled scientific decisions, evidence traceability and methodological guidance.

interface.longDescription: Orientação científica com estratégias metodológicas, evidências [L]/[I]/[P], rastreabilidade, C.A.D.A. e sete gates sob controle do pesquisador. Funcionalidades externas dependem de acesso verificado.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Meu Artigo to orient my research. Verify accessible tools and canonical storage, distinguish [L]/[I]/[P], present A/B/C/D choices with pros and cons when appropriate, and preserve all seven gates pending until actual individual researcher review.
